title: Reset-arm snippet change has zero effective regression coverage — the grep-guard pin also matches the pre-existing consent-rejection arm
evidence:
Guard pin (Makefile:274 / Dockerfile:133): 'document.cookie="rt_landlord_id=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax";rtPhId=null'

Reset arm (the CHANGED code this guard was added to defend): rt_ph_reset=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax";document.cookie="rt_landlord_id=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax";rtPhId=null;window.posthog.reset()

Consent-rejection arm (PRE-EXISTING, unchanged by this PR): opt_out_capturing();document.cookie="rt_landlord_id=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax";rtPhId=null

`grep -c` of the consent-rejection arm in each file's snippet line: Makefile:1 / Dockerfile:1 — i.e. the pinned substring is present in the consent-rejection arm independent of the reset-arm edit. No runtime test covers it either: .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/analytics/identify-bridge.yaml drives email/password login only and ASSERT 2 checks identity-rotation + rt_ph_reset consumed but never asserts rt_landlord_id is absent on logout.
detail: The guard pin is not unique to the reset arm — the consent-rejection arm already contained that exact substring. Reverting the reset-arm clear would pass both Makefile and Dockerfile guards, so the privacy fix has no regression protection.
recommended_fix: Pin a substring unique to the reset arm, e.g. the rt_ph_reset-clear→rt_landlord_id-clear adjacency: document.cookie="rt_ph_reset=; Max-Age=0; Path=/; SameSite=Lax";document.cookie="rt_landlord_id=

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 surfaces (server-side identify+capture + signup_completed/login_succeeded polarity + is_new from (xmax=0)) are FULL: oauth_first_signin_fires_identify_and_signup_completed_test and oauth_returning_signin_fires_login_succeeded_test drive complete_oauth_flow against the real DB and assert distinct_id==row.id, email $set, empty $set_once, and the correct event per branch. P1 cookie-lifetime surfaces FULL: identify_cookie_is_js_readable_and_short_lived_test pins Max-Age=60; cookie_attributes_match_sentinel_pattern_test and clear_session_cookies_carries_ph_reset_sentinel_test pin Max-Age=10 on both sentinels. The 4-place reset-arm snippet contract is the sole gap: the added grep guards are false-positives (see coverage-gap finding) and no runtime/E2E test exercises the logout-before-identify edge case the reset-arm clear exists for.
detail: P0 100%, P1 ~80% (reset-arm regression coverage effectively none), overall ~90%. Meets CONCERNS band (P1 80-89%): critical OAuth funnel is solid, but one load-bearing privacy surface has no test that would fail on regression.
recommended_fix: Make the reset-arm grep pin unique to the changed arm (pin the rt_ph_reset→rt_landlord_id adjacency) so a revert fails the guard; optionally add a bug-hunt assertion that rt_landlord_id is absent immediately after logout.
